Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
And praise be to Allah who favored us

Arabic text: بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: With Muhammad, His Prophet, peace be upon him and his family
Above the past nations and bygone generations

Arabic text: بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِيْ لَا تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْءٍ وَ إِنْ عَظُمَ
Translation: By His power that is never incapable of anything, however great

Arabic text: وَ لَا يَفُوتُهَا شَيْءٌ وَ إِنْ لَطُفَ
Translation: And nothing escapes it, however subtle

Arabic text: فَخَتَمَ بِنَا عَلَى جَمِيْعِ مَنْ ذَرَأَ
Translation: Thus He sealed with us over all those He created

Arabic text: وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ
Translation: And made us witnesses over those who denied
And multiplied us by His favor over those who were few

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your trustee over Your revelation
And Your chosen one from Your creation
And Your pure one from among Your servants
The leader of mercy and the guide to goodness
And the key to blessing
Just as he dedicated himself to Your command
And exposed his body to hardship for Your sake
And confronted his close relatives in calling to You
And fought his family for Your pleasure
And severed his family ties to revive Your religion
And distanced the nearest ones for their denial

Arabic text: وَ قَرَّبَ الْأَقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ
Translation: And brought closer the distant ones for their response to You
And befriended the remote ones for Your sake
And opposed the closest ones for Your sake

Arabic text: وَ أَدْأَبَ نَفْسَهُ فِيْ تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ
Translation: And exhausted himself in delivering Your message
And tired himself by calling to Your path
And occupied himself with advising the people of Your call
And migrated to the land of exile
And the place distant from the home of his residence
And the place of his foot and the birthplace of his head

Arabic text: وَمَأْنَسِ نَفْسِهِ إِرَادَةً مِنْهُ لِإِعْزَازِ دِينِكَ
Translation: And the comfort of his soul, out of his desire to elevate Your religion
And to seek victory over the people who disbelieved in You

Arabic text: حَتَّى اسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِيْ أَعْدَائِكَ
Translation: Until what he attempted against Your enemies was accomplished

Arabic text: وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِيْ أَوْلِيَائِكَ
Translation: And what he planned for Your friends was completed
So he rose against them, seeking victory through Your help
And strengthening his weakness with Your support
And he fought them in the heart of their lands
And attacked them in the midst of their settlements
Until Your command prevailed
And Your word was exalted, even though the polytheists disliked it
O Allah, raise him for his struggles for Your sake
To the highest level of Your paradise
Until he is not equaled in rank
Nor matched in status

Arabic text: وَلَا يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلَا نَبِيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
Translation: And no angel close to You nor prophet sent by You can parallel him before You
And make known to him among his pure family
And his believing nation, the excellence of his intercession

Arabic text: أَجَلَّ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ يَا نَافِذَ الْعِدَةِ
Translation: The most sublime of what You promised him, O Fulfiller of promises

Arabic text: يَا وَافِيَ الْقَوْلِ يَا مُبَدِّلَ السَّيِّئَاتِ بِأَضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
Translation: O Keeper of words, O Transformer of sins into manifold good deeds
Indeed, You are the Possessor of great bounty
